Results.ReviewText: Seems well made, but the materials could be a little beefier. I'm afraid in a good windstorm I might have to go to the neighbors to retrieve my grill, (just kidding),  but it is very lightweight compared to other models I have owned. The burners seem to be spaced a little further from the cooking grates than other models I have owned, so cooking times are a little longer. This isn't a problem,  just be aware. I do like the grease tray with the aluminum pans. One improvement you could do would be to make the shelf on the left side have a locking feature and a handle so that the grill could be moved around more easily. Overall I like my new Weber grill, and for my family it is just the right size for any home cookout that we have. I would of given it 5 stars if the materials were a thicker gauge.
Results.Title: Good so far, but ask me again in a year or two.

I was all ready to make some burgers and dogs when the grill was delivered, but the store brought out a natural gas unit instead of the propane I selected.  So, it took a couple of days to sort everything out and now it’s Memorial Day.  I had planned to cook something easy to figure out the hot spots and play with the temp and Burners, but now it was going to have to be ribs first, and learn later.

Quick take was that the grill worked perfectly and allowed our large family to enjoy tender ribs on a special day.  The indirect heat worked fine, and the temp held steady.
Results.Title: Ribs First

Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I’ve made some wonderful dinners on my new bbq. I got a Weber because I’m new to grilling and wanted quality over quantity. It has made some wonderful steaks, burgers, and vegetables. However, I did expect the grilling to be a little more even as I heard that’s what Weber prided themselves on. Some pieces I put on at the same time but one is charred and the other still needs a few minutes to cook. Secondly, if I turn one burner off and leave two on, I hear a whistling noise(like it’s still letting a little propane be pushed through) I’m unsure but it results in me feeling obligated to leave all burners on even when it’s unnecessary, causing more propane to be wasted. I’ve gone through a full tank in just 3 weeks (however, I do like grilling :). Maybe I needed to buy one of the more expensive Weber grills? Mine was in the mid range price. And although Home Depot offers free delivery and assembly for Weber grills I was forced to rent a truck from Home Depot and transport it myself (paying extra) due to covid precautions of no more deliveries to households. So since I bought buy grill at this time of year I didn’t receive the same accommodations other customers receive for the same purchase. Overall, I’d still recommend Weber because I’ve tried cheap grills before and there is no comparison.
Results.Title: Great bbq, but not perfect
